patch.value: Classify the published CLI divergences, update native parity and validate the locked npm oracle on Linux.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: Started from the Dependabot head. npm latest is 2026.11.18. Reviewing the failed matrix and reproducing against the current pin.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: All seven failed jobs in run 44015087729 report two cases. GH-1707 in 2026.11.13 introduces credential-bearing identity admission and stored-holder redaction. Direct 2026.11.18 probes confirm stored holders are redacted without requiring credential restoration from a clean invocation. The full Linux run also confirms GH-1684 and GH-1703 in 2026.11.14 change TOON receipts and budgeted row counts, and GH-1336 in 2026.11.16 adds claim activity evidence. Implementing these wire changes while the remaining suites run.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: Published 2026.11.18 accepts the unchanged replay at the old TOON overhead boundary. The same stale-output-cursor defect remains at an adjacent second-projection boundary, with successful replay on either side. Saved an upstream draft after checking related issues. Native already had this stale replay behavior. Kept the existing reprojected-snapshot test and tracked the separate GH-1336 takeover and next write/read work under pm-rust-stale-claim-takeover.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: GH-1706 in 2026.11.14 is another intended change exposed past the original CI stop. Published CLI probes confirm automatic expired session-lease reclamation and stale_lock_requires_override for a retained item lease. Adopted typed lock guidance and post-commit attribution warnings, plus the GH-1724 nonzero context ownership and idle counts.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: The current Linux format and all-target Clippy gates pass. The published .18 stored-holder comparison and the updated TOON budget and continuation boundary cases passed their focused runs. The full Linux and ownership matrix runs are in progress. Opening the superseding PR as a draft while those gates complete.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: Opened draft PR 181 at 9ac32be. Its first CI run passed tracker policy, release quality and quick crash checks. Quick Rust identified the outdated release-I/O assertion and context advisory alias mismatch. Both are corrected. The published claim/holder/session lease focused cases passed 3 of 3, the advisory alias oracle test passed, and all 20 refusal unit tests passed. The native list now reconstructs its second projection to replay the emitted cursor; the regression test verifies that changing the source still refuses.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: At 6920d21, the local Linux unit suites passed all 458 library and 83 CLI tests. The next CI run exposed a context budget mismatch and one optional usage-feedback warning in the ownership fixture. The documented 2026.11.14 UTF-16 compaction suffix now matches the published context output at budgets 100, 1000 and 1200, and the real-copy oracle test passed. The mutation fixture disables unrelated usage feedback. The 2026.11.12 GH-1700 and 2026.11.14 GH-1716 linked-test and artifact receipts and note policy are implemented, with six direct published file comparisons and four focused unit and oracle regressions passing.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: The native linked-test removal receipt now matches the published CLI byte for byte. The focused SDK linked-note refusal test verifies both authoritative files stay byte-identical and confirms explicit append returns only the edited link. Formatting, Clippy and the focused context and list cursor checks pass. The all-target Linux and broad collection runs remain in progress. PR 154 depends on these overlapping changes landing first.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: Exact ac3ab0c CI exposed one stale bare-ellipsis assertion in the surrogate-preservation unit. Updated the assertion for the published UTF-16 count. All 59 ownership differential tests passed locally. The published 2026.11.18 linked-note append treats a requested phrase already present across adjacent semicolon-delimited parts as unchanged, which the native SDK now preserves on retries.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: The same CI run passed all 38 orientation oracle tests. Its ownership acceptance test still expected release to exit after committing the item, so updated it to verify the documented 2026.11.14 success receipt, its warning and its retry advice with the on-disk state assertions preserved.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: Locally, all 11 ownership SDK acceptance cases passed with the updated release assertion. The ac3ab0c linked collection oracle completed with zero differences across its fixtures. A further probe verified the published test command rejects the artifact-only note-conflict flag before mutating linked tests. Native now rejects it too, and the full collection oracle includes that command in both renderers.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: All 459 library tests passed after updating the compaction expectation and linked-note retry case. The linked ownership acceptance command passed under pm test with progress. Formatting and all-target Clippy passed. The unsupported linked-test flag now matches the published refusal byte for byte in text and JSON and leaves the item and journal unchanged.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: At cd70569 all three platform shard-two Rust jobs and coverage shard two passed. Shard one found three legacy CLI fixtures attempting to create forbidden identities via the modern claim path. Direct comparisons with 2026.11.18 confirmed broader whole-value masking for some previously stored holders. The CLI refusal now masks the holder and detail with that rule while retaining the existing protection for copied sensitive text. Legacy fixtures seed older durable data directly.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: Tracked the remaining raw direct-SDK error projection under pm-rust-sdk-holder-projection. The CLI applies whole-value masking before rendering while supporting its existing copied-text protections.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: The whole-value legacy holder refusal now matches published JSON byte for byte. Both focused legacy holder CLI cases pass, and the complete public prose close-recovery corpus passed with the updated fixtures. Formatting and all-target Clippy passed. The full published collection comparison passed, and the isolated session-attribution differential passed after its concurrent Linux failure.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: Exact e3e057f Ubuntu CI reached mutation acceptance after passing the 41 CLI dispatch tests. A stale SDK assertion assumed unreadable history would prevent the foreign claim refusal. The published 2026.11.18 CLI and native CLI return byte-identical already_claimed_by receipts with history_unreadable true and stale false for the synthetic directory case. Updated the acceptance test to verify the typed fallback and unchanged item and to retain the separate journal recovery assertions.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: The GH-1710 root cursor fix is present in the published oracle. Its long producer cursor matches native and replays in both implementations. The same release family over-applies cursor preservation to item fields with those names. Synthetic 2026.11.11 and 2026.11.18 CLI comparisons and a one-field control confirm the newer version omits rows at the tight budget. The draft captures this distinct regression. Native keeps nested data compactable, with deliberate divergence at the tight budget and byte parity at the wider budget.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: All 41 dispatch cases, 29 mutation acceptance cases, and both generated output-parity cases passed locally. The three focused pagination cases passed against the pinned oracle. In particular, both CLIs deliver byte-identical exit-2 receipts for the full triage query at the default effective cap. Both upstream draft reproductions were run from their exact saved code and yielded their passing controls.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: At 1caff0a all six Rust jobs passed. Both coverage shards passed, and CI run 44297971605 computed 99.4681 percent lines, 99.6641 functions, 99.3810 regions and 98.0291 branches. The aggregate requires 100 percent in each dimension. Tracked under pm-rust-oracle-1118-coverage. The local Linux all-target run passed the first unit suites, all 59 ownership oracle cases and all 41 CLI dispatch cases. PR 154 still awaits the overlapping changes on main.

value.author: codex-sol

value.author: codex-sol
value.text:
Round DZ review of pm-rust#181 at 516d391 against pm-cli 2026.11.18. All 15 findings apply.
PRRT_kwDOTwgMRs65d2tN — native_note_repair_replays_only_in_the_selected_tracker and linked_note_recovery_matches_published_semantics. The oracle accepts a separate hyphen-leading note, and the native retry retains that grammar and the following flags.
PRRT_kwDOTwgMRs65d2tU — sdk_collection_reads_ignore_the_artifact_base. SDK listing and linked-test operations ignore unused directories, including an empty path.
PRRT_kwDOTwgMRs65d2tX — collection_restore_after_removal_is_read_only and cli_omitted_rows_retain_tracker_root_as_invocation_directory. SDK restores use the selected absolute tracker and replay from another tracker with the same ID. CLI relative and non-UTF-8 guidance are verified separately.
PRRT_kwDOTwgMRs65d2ta — private_sdk_principals_refuse_before_storage. Explicit and scoped invalid principals refuse before forced pause can modify item, history or session bytes. The published CLI rejects the corresponding invalid author before mutation.
PRRT_kwDOTwgMRs65d2tn — claim_eligibility_handles_the_utc_year_boundary. The pinned oracle reports +010000-01-01T00:30:00.000Z across the boundary. Native gives null outside its UTC range and matches the in-range value.
PRRT_kwDOTwgMRs65d2tx — ownership_session_faults_and_contention_preserve_durable_steps. Both implementations save the release on lock contention. The oracle says nothing needs a retry. Native now directs callers to check and reconcile only session attribution after the lock clears.
PRRT_kwDOTwgMRs65d2t1 — stale_session_lock_lifecycle_matches_published_bytes. Owned and unowned pause, claim, release and start each assert stale lock removal in both trackers.
PRRT_kwDOTwgMRs65d2t6 — reclaimed_session_writer_cannot_replace_new_attribution. A disconnected channel aborts publication and leaves the session unchanged. Successor publication still fences the old writer.
PRRT_kwDOTwgMRs65d2uB — session_publication_waits_for_transient_cleanup_gate. The publisher releases the fixture gate only after observing actual contention. The next acquisition publishes the snapshot.
PRRT_kwDOTwgMRs65kcQN — artifact_cwd_file_refusal_preserves_item_and_history and artifact_cwd_resolves_root_alias_without_following_its_suffix. A regular file in the base or its ancestry refuses before any write, and a missing directory still anchors the link. The flag is native-only.
PRRT_kwDOTwgMRs65kcQU — project_alias_removal_preserves_internal_directory_symlinks. Project-root alias and direct logical removal select the same stored path. An alias directly into a project subdirectory also remains usable.
PRRT_kwDOTwgMRs65kcQb — projected_collection_recovery_keeps_the_selected_binary and encoded_identity_projection_preserves_native_recovery. Redaction covers copies of encoded identity credentials while retaining public message text. The published CLI also protects the copied fixture.
PRRT_kwDOTwgMRs65kcQj — session_acquisition_refreshes_the_clock_on_retry. Deterministic samples prove an initially live lease expires within the wait and the new receipt uses the successful attempt's clock, matching the oracle's per-attempt policy.
PRRT_kwDOTwgMRs65kcQp — recency_honors_event_classes_and_legacy_paths plus the orientation differential. Established event classes take precedence, and the fallback uses borrowed paths with the existing maintenance and malformed-path behavior.
PRRT_kwDOTwgMRs65kcQ2 — projected_collection_recovery_keeps_the_selected_binary and encoded_identity_projection_preserves_native_recovery. Projected recovery retains pm-rust for its native-only flag and pm for published arguments.

Gate evidence
Formatting, deny-warnings Clippy, changelog check and both profile-union fixtures passed.
The standard Rust unit, binary, CLI dispatch, ownership, claim/release, search/collections and orientation cases passed across the full run and focused retries. Final full unit rerun passed 519 library and 63 binary tests. The existing five-second dependency packet deadline recurred during concurrent runs, then the unchanged case passed in isolation. This behavior is tracked in pm-rust-local-packet-deadline.
